operating_notes.text: Zintrodiazine Phase III trials: 651 patients (P. falciparum) and 390 patients (P. vivax mono-infection), per DCGI permission dated April 25, 2026.
USFDA inspection at Unit 9 facility (Biologics Injectable plant, Ahmedabad) concluded on May 5, 2026, with 7 observations and no data integrity issues.
Zydus Worldwide DMCC agreed to acquire Assertio Holdings, Inc. for USD 23.50 per share in cash, totaling approx USD 166.4 million.
Zydus Lifesciences and subsidiaries completed the investment of Rs. 90.18 million (₹9.02 Cr) under Tranches 2, 3, and 4 in Torrent Urja 25.
US FDA granted Priority Review to saroglitazar NDA for treatment of PBC with PDUFA date of November 27, 2026.
Buyback Committee approved increasing the buyback price to ₹1,260 per share and reducing maximum shares to 87,30,158.
USFDA Warning Letter issued for Baddi facility regarding talc quality
US branded business is 10% of US revenue now, expected above 15% once Assertio consolidates from the next quarter.
Rolvedon (Assertio) guided at $15-20 million per quarter run-rate from the next quarter.
Zydus Biotech Park injectable facility received an EIR with VAI classification after April-May 2026 GMP inspection.
USFDA accepted BLA for FYB206 (Keytruda biosimilar) for review, with a potential decision expected in Q3 2027.
USFDA approved ANDA for Estradiol and Levonorgestrel Transdermal System, designated as CGT with 180-day exclusivity
Zylidac Bio partners with Prolific Machines to scale biologics manufacturing platform to GMP production

holders.name: Quant Mutual Fund - Quant Multi Cap Fund

timeline.summary: Zydus Lifesciences received DCGI approval to initiate Phase III trials for anti-malarial candidate Zintrodiazine.
Zydus Lifesciences incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Zara Merger SUB Inc in the US on April 24, 2026
Zydus Lifesciences completes acquisition of 100% of FBC Medical, France for €700,000 on April 30, 2026
Zydus Lifesciences subsidiary Zydus VTEC received a ₹0.90 Cr tax demand and equal penalty under CGST Act.
USFDA GMP surveillance inspection at Zydus' Unit 9 biologics plant in Ahmedabad concluded with 7 observations and zero data integrity findings.
Zydus Lifesciences agreed to acquire U.S.-based Assertio Holdings for approximately USD 166.4 million in cash.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited, as promoter of Zydus Wellness Limited, declared no encumbrances on shares for FY2026 on April 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,587 Cr (+16.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,272.5 Cr (+1647.9% YoY).
Zydus Lifesciences approved a share buyback of up to ₹1,100 Cr at ₹1,150 per share with May 29, 2026 as the record date.
Zydus Lifesciences reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹7,587 Cr, up 16.2% YoY, with an EBITDA margin of 33.7% and approved a share buyback of up to ₹1,100 Cr.
Zydus Lifesciences made available the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 financial results investor call on May 19, 2026.
Zydus Lifesciences completed its equity subscription in Torrent Urja 25 by investing ₹9.02 Cr for the remaining tranches on May 19, 2026.
US FDA granted Priority Review to Zydus Therapeutics' NDA for saroglitazar with a PDUFA date of November 27, 2026.
Zydus Lifesciences revised its buyback terms on May 27, 2026, increasing the price to ₹1,260 per share and reducing the shares to 87,30,158 for ₹1,100 Cr.
Zydus Lifesciences issued the letter of offer for its ₹1,100 Cr buyback at ₹1,260 per share, scheduled to open on June 4, 2026.
Zydus Lifesciences submitted the revised Letter of Offer for its ₹1,100 Cr buyback scheduled from June 4 to June 10, 2026.
2026-06-03: Zydus Lifesciences receives USFDA Warning Letter for Baddi facility over talc quality
Zydus Lifesciences announced that the USFDA accepted for review the BLA for FYB206, a Keytruda biosimilar developed with Formycon.
2026-10-13: USFDA inspection concludes at Zydus' manufacturing plant at Moraiya, Ahmedabad with 5 observations
2026-10-13: Zydus Sunshine Lifesciences signs agreement with Board of Investment, Sri Lanka to establish a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka
2026-10-21: Zydus receives USFDA approval for Estradiol and Levonorgestrel Transdermal System, eligible for 180-day CGT exclusivity
2026-10-21: Zylidac Bio partners with Prolific Machines to scale biologics manufacturing platform to GMP production
